# `product_order_item`

Area: **ordering** ([all tables](README.md))

SID ProductOrderItem (TMF622 productOrderItem): one add or delete of one product. At most one open delete item per product (partial unique index).

| Column | Type | Null | Default | Description |

| `id` | `uuid` | no | `gen_random_uuid()` | Primary key, generated by the database (gen_random_uuid()). |

| `state` | `product_order_item_state_type` (enum, see [README](README.md#enums)) | yes |  | TMF622 item state: completed, rejected or cancelled once processed; NULL while the order is a draft. |
